notes:
Account summary: stalled -> closed-lost due to security attestation gaps. Prospect is an enterprise regtech firm handling regulated underwriting datasets. They requested Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and extremely strict GRC controls. Timeline and key points:

- 2025-10-12: MQL -> AE outreach (Aisha). Intro call 10/20: product fit looks good, use-cases: automated redaction, compliance Q&A, summarization for audit logs.
- 2025-11-03: Discovery w/ SE (Mateo). Ran basic POC: chat + redaction pipeline. POC successful at functional level. Fireflies: ff-2025-11-03-Polaris-Discovery.
- 2025-11-15: Shared pricing deck + security FAQ (drive:/deals/polaris/2025-11/pricing-deck-v3.pdf, drive:/security/polaris/security-faq-redwood.pdf).
- 2025-12-02: Polaris sent 120-question security questionnaire (standard enterprise GRC). SE responded; uploaded SOC2 summary and network diagram.
- 2026-01-15: GRC call with security leads and legal. Prospect required: ISO27001 certificate (company-level), recent independent penetration test report, and ability to store keys in their HSM. Fireflies: ff-2026-01-15-GRC-Security-Call.
- 2026-01-20 -> 2026-02-10: multiple follow-ups via email (thread-security-qa-2026-01-20). We offered Dedicated + contractual audit logging and customer-managed KMS, and a formal attestation letter for SOC2.
- 2026-02-18: Polaris legal responded: attestation letter insufficient; they need ISO27001 and a redacted pen-test report to satisfy internal auditors. Stated quote: "We cannot onboard without independent certs and pen test evidence."
- 2026-02-20: Final internal decision: procurement to pause Redwood; option to go with alternate vendor who provided ISO27001 and shared a redacted pen-test report. Marked closed-lost.

Notes / objections observed:
- Primary blocker was not price or performance; it was compliance evidence.
- Polaris would not accept roadmap commitments — they required existing certs and artifacts.
- No internal champion after GRC escalation; head of platform pulled procurement back to vendor list.

Next actions attempted (post-decision):
- Offered temporary mitigations: subprocessor list, SOC2 bridge letter, offer to run customer-specific attestation within Dedicated setup. Rejected.
- Proposed pilot in isolated on-prem package (security-only contract) but legal unwilling to proceed without ISO27001.

Suggested for future similar accounts:
- Early mapping: flag ISO/ISO27001 requirement during discovery for regtech/healthcare prospects.
- Quick checklist: if ISO27001 required, accelerate procurement of redacted pen-test evidence or partner arrangement to provide third-party validation.
- Capture single-source GRC contact to maintain champion after security call (we lost ours after GRC escalated).

CRM shorthand/comments: "closed-lost - GRC required ISO + pen test; competitor provided certs and evidence; revisit if Polaris updates vendor policy or after Redwood obtains ISO."

Linked artifacts: pricing deck and security FAQ in Drive, fireflies recordings above, gmail threads for follow-up, tickets INF-4327 / SEC-5019 tracked SE questions and security gating items.
